mapper.select:
SELECT TraceId AS traceId, argMin(ServiceName, Timestamp) AS rootService, argMin(SpanName, Timestamp) AS rootName, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(min(Timestamp)) AS startTime, toUInt64(max(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp) + Duration) - min(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp))) AS durationNs, toUInt32(count()) AS spanCount, toUInt32(countIf(StatusCode = 'Error')) AS errorCount, if(countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') > 0, 'Error', 'Ok') AS status, any(ResourceAttributes) AS resourceAttributes
ORDER BY
durationNs spanCount startTime
ASC DESC
LIMIT ${limit} OFFSET ${offset}
